title: List every subset
prompt: Return every subset of items, in any order. A subset is any selection of the items, including none of them and all of them. The items are all different. Three items have 8 subsets.
hints: What are the subsets of an empty list? There is exactly one.
Take the first item away. Every subset of the whole list is a subset of the rest, either without the first item or with it.
Base case: return [[]]. Otherwise get the subsets of the rest, and return them together with a copy of each that has the first item added.
checkLabels: An empty list has one subset: the empty one.

wrongAnswers.misconception: Returns no subsets for an empty list, so there is nothing to build on.
Keeps only the subsets that contain the first item.

feedback: Check the base case first: the empty list has one subset, not none. Then check that each call returns both groups.
